Quan sat form nhap thong tin thanh toan.

open_question_draft.proposed_question: Oracle cua check 'CHK-002' dang dua tren KB item KB-003, co confirmation_source.derivation='code_artifact' (phat bieu suy tu doc hanh vi code hien tai, khong phai mot yeu cau tuong minh). Theo Gate C5 'phanh derivation', check chi duoc oracle_strength STRONG khi MOI oracle.kb_ids deu CONFIRMED_EXPECTED va derivation='prose'. Ha xuong BASELINE + NEEDS_CONFIRMATION cho toi khi co xac nhan tu nguon manh hon.

checks.title: [KNOWN DEFECT - khong phai expected result] PayoutBlock.vue hardcode payment_method_id=1(PayPal)/2(Payoneer) de ap dieu kien hien thi rut tien
checks.precondition: Affiliate co payment_method_id=1 (gia dinh la PayPal theo quy uoc hardcode) hoac id=2 (gia dinh la Payoneer).
steps: Dang nhap bang affiliate co payment_method_id = 1.
Mo khu vuc hien thi dieu kien rut tien (PayoutBlock) tren dashboard.
Lap lai voi affiliate co payment_method_id = 2.
checks.observation_point: Noi dung dieu kien rut tien hien thi tren PayoutBlock cho ca 2 truong hop.
checks.expected_result: PayoutBlock hien 'can balance > $50 moi rut duoc' khi payment_method_id===1, va 'khong gioi han toi thieu' khi payment_method_id===2 - BAT KE PaymentMethod#1/#2 thuc te co ten/field gi (component DOC doc field nao tu PaymentMethod de suy ra dieu kien, chi dua vao ID). DAY LA HANH VI HIEN TAI CUA HE THONG (known defect), KHONG PHAI ky vong dung. Pham vi brand cua defect nay con UNCERTAIN theo doc-ingest-explorer (xem open_question_draft) - can xac nhan co ap dung cho moi brand/instance hay chi 1 brand cu the. Neu lan chay sau phat hien component doc dung field tu PaymentMethod thay vi hardcode ID, do la 1 THAY DOI can xac nhan lai voi PO/dev.

DAY LA HANH VI HIEN TAI CUA HE THONG (known defect, he qua truc tiep cua CHK-007), KHONG PHAI ky vong dung.

checks.title: [KNOWN DEFECT - khong phai expected result] Affiliate co the thay dieu kien rut tien SAI LECH tren UI nhung backend van quyet dinh dung

checks.expected_result: Backend (InvoiceService::canCreateByUser) van ra quyet dinh DUNG theo dieu kien thuc (khong phu thuoc ID), KHONG bi anh huong boi dieu kien SAI da hien thi tren UI - tuc gay nham lan trai nghiem cho affiliate (ho co the thay thong bao sai) nhung KHONG gay sai so tien thuc te duoc rut.
